_comment: Independent venues read through the generic schema.org adapter.
National discovery comes from OpenStreetMap amenity=cinema records.
This file is only a routing/parser override registry for known venues
whose ticketing platform or markup needs explicit handling.
`markup` records what was observed at capture time:
usable      - ScreeningEvent nodes with real startDate values
decorative  - valid markup, empty startDate; raises IncompleteStructuredData
A decorative venue is not a broken config. It is a venue that needs a
per-venue HTML fallback parser, and it stays listed so that work is
visible instead of the venue silently vanishing.
markup: 'vista-links' means showtimes come from embedded Vista ticket anchors rather than schema.org.
markup: 'agile-links' means showtimes come from Agile WebSales anchors, which additionally carry a sales state and screen name.
fetch: 'browser' reads the page through Chromium, for venues behind a JS interstitial.

venues.name: Film Forum
venues.notes: 56 ScreeningEvent nodes, every startDate empty. Format lives in the event title ('THE THIRD MAN in 35mm').

venues.name: IFC Center
venues.notes: Agile WebSales at tickets.ifccenter.com. 140 showtimes across 5+ dates. Bare anchors, plain <h3> titles, textual 'Sun Aug 2' day headings.

venues.name: The Roxie
venues.notes: WordPress, own-site ticketing. 34 showtimes from clickable time links.

venues.name: Music Box Theatre
venues.notes: Sucuri JS interstitial - a plain client gets 1.3KB of obfuscated script, so this one is read through the browser. 12 showtimes; the day is in a visually-hidden span beside each time.

venues.name: Castro Theatre
venues.notes: Now programmed largely as a concert venue (APE/Ticketmaster/TicketWeb); no film showtime markup found.

venues.name: Metrograph
venues.notes: Vista ticketing at t.metrograph.com, cinemacode 9999. 183 showtimes across 20 dates via embedded ticket links.

venues.name: Coolidge Corner Theatre
venues.notes: Agile WebSales at store.coolidge.org. 24 showtimes incl. 'The Odyssey in 70mm' on screen MH1; sales-state gives real availability.
